content.user_title: Improve SEO Reviews for Web Pages
content.value_statement: Web pages often miss basic metadata, semantic structure, and social sharing signals. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through focused SEO review steps.
actual_capabilities: Reviews title tags, meta descriptions, canonical URLs, and social preview metadata.
Checks heading hierarchy, single H1 usage, and semantic page landmarks.
Identifies missing or weak image alt text in page markup.
Gives Next.js App Router and Pages Router metadata guidance.
Prompts SEO review questions that connect code choices to search visibility.
limitations: Does not crawl live websites or measure production search rankings.
Does not replace a full technical SEO audit with analytics data.
Does not generate keyword strategy from market research.
Requires page code or markup context to produce useful feedback.

use_cases.title: Review a Landing Page
use_cases.description: Check a marketing page for strong titles, descriptions, headings, alt text, and social preview tags.

use_cases.title: Teach SEO Basics During Code Review
use_cases.description: Use guided questions to help junior developers understand search-friendly HTML structure.

use_cases.title: Audit Next.js Metadata
use_cases.description: Verify App Router or Pages Router metadata patterns before a page ships.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Page Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this page for SEO fundamentals. Focus on title, meta description, H1, headings, semantic HTML, and image alt text.

prompt_templates.title: Next.js Metadata Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of a Next.js page or layout.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Next.js component for metadata quality. Check title, description, canonical URL, Open Graph tags, and router-specific patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Accessibility Linked SEO Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review that connects search and accessibility.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this markup for SEO and accessibility overlap. Prioritize semantic landmarks, heading order, descriptive alt text, and readable link context.

prompt_templates.title: Release Readiness Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced pre-launch review for a public page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a pre-launch SEO review for this public page. List blockers, improvements, and validation steps for metadata, structure, and social previews.

output_examples.input: A product page has a generic title, no meta description, two H1 headings, and missing alt text.
output_examples.output: The review flags the title and description as search result issues, recommends one clear H1, and asks for descriptive alt text.

output_examples.input: A Next.js page exports metadata with a title and description but lacks social preview fields.
output_examples.output: The review confirms the basic metadata and recommends Open Graph title, description, image, URL, and type fields.

output_examples.input: A page uses div elements for header, navigation, main content, and footer areas.
output_examples.output: The review recommends semantic landmarks so search engines and assistive tools can understand the page structure.

best_practices: Provide the full page component or HTML head so the review can inspect real context.
Ask for prioritized issues when reviewing pages close to release.
Validate social previews and metadata after applying recommendations.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for ranking guarantees from metadata-only changes.
Do not review isolated tags without the page purpose or visible heading structure.
Do not treat placeholder titles, descriptions, or images as production-ready SEO content.

faq.question: Does this skill improve search rankings directly?
faq.answer: No. It improves code quality signals that help search engines understand pages.

faq.question: Can it review Next.js App Router metadata?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for exported metadata in App Router pages and layouts.

faq.question: Can it review Pages Router Head usage?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks common Head patterns for titles, descriptions, and social metadata.

faq.question: Does it perform keyword research?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on technical and structural SEO basics in provided code.

faq.question: Does it require live website access?
faq.answer: No. It works from page code, markup, or component snippets supplied in the conversation.

faq.question: Can non-specialists use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The review uses clear questions and checklists for common SEO issues.
